notes: Every public-profile opening receives a synchronous generation and owns a cancellable preliminary-load job as well as its observer job.
A later opening, clearUserProfile and close invalidate the previous generation before cancellation, so stale cache or observer results are rejected even when a data source ignores cancellation.
Hermetic common tests cover A-to-B navigation with suspended cache, a stale non-cooperative observer response, clear during cache loading and close during cache loading.
This focal reduction does not rerun or replace the existing Android, Web and iOS PROF-ENTRY evidence. It does not certify deep navigation, backend errors, retry UI or unrelated profile races.
After #415 was rebased and frozen, this product patch rebased with the same stable patch-id c19e498e88a353ed122dbfb97fdc1f362c1259ba; the affected Wasm test was rerun on the new Product SHA.
